senses.en_definition: An expression of agreement, acceptance, or readiness to proceed; all right; okay.

messages.en: Let's meet at the main entrance at seven, okay? It'll be easier to find each other there.
All right, see you there later. I'm heading out now.
He took my money and then just disappeared. What a bastard!
Just keep all those messages. Let's report him to the police.

senses.en_definition: A garment, usually worn on the upper body; also used in the names of outfits covering more of the body.

collocations.en: a traditional Malay women's outfit consisting of a loose tunic and a long skirt
a traditional Malay men's outfit consisting of a long-sleeved shirt and trousers

messages.en: This top's really nice, but they're sold out in my size. They've only got size S left.
Try asking that shop assistant. They might have it in stock at another branch.
I want to introduce you to my husband-to-be tomorrow.
Wow, congratulations! I can't wait to meet him.
